title: Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh Welcome Their Second Daughter
excerpt: The couple announced the birth of their second daughter, born September 19, in a joint social media post signed "Dua, Deepika & Ranveer" — crediting their first daughter, Dua, born in September 2024, with welcoming her baby sister.
body:
• Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh announced the birth of their second daughter, born September 19, 2026, in a joint social media post featuring an image of the newborn's footprint and the words "Welcome Baby Girl."
  • The post was signed "Dua, Deepika & Ranveer," giving the couple's first daughter — Dua Padukone Singh, born September 8, 2024 — her own credit line in welcoming her baby sister.
  • The announcement came a day after the couple was photographed seeking blessings at Mumbai's Siddhivinayak Temple, mirroring a similar visit they made before Dua's birth in September 2024.
  • Congratulatory messages poured in from across the film industry, including Kriti Sanon, Sonam Kapoor, Anil Kapoor and Neil Nitin Mukesh.

Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh are parents again. The couple announced on Saturday that their second daughter was born on September 19, 2026, sharing the news in a joint social media post that featured the tiny imprint of the newborn's feet alongside the words "Welcome Baby Girl." The card carried the date 19|9|2026 and was signed "Dua, Deepika & Ranveer" — a deliberate nod to their first daughter, Dua, who turns the family of three into four.

The arrival comes almost exactly two years after Dua Padukone Singh was born on September 8, 2024, and caps a pregnancy the couple announced publicly on April 19, 2026, with a social media post showing Dua holding a positive pregnancy test. The new baby's name has not been announced.

A deliberately low-key reveal

The couple has guarded their children's privacy closely. They did not reveal Dua's name until November 2024, two months after her birth, and waited a full year before showing her face on social media. The footprint motif continues that pattern: a public announcement that shares the joy without sharing the child.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=FUwBpar2mmg

The timing followed a familiar ritual. A day before the birth, Deepika and Ranveer were photographed at Mumbai's Siddhivinayak Temple, arriving in traditional attire amid tight security as fans gathered outside. Ranveer also visited the Lalbaugcha Raja pandal earlier in the week to offer prayers. The couple had made a similar pilgrimage to Siddhivinayak in September 2024, shortly before Dua was born.

Earlier this month, the couple had offered fans a glimpse of the final weeks of the pregnancy, posting new photographs on Dua's second birthday on September 8 that showed Deepika's baby bump. "Baby Dua and our hearts are getting bigger! Thank you for your blessings," they wrote at the time.

Industry colleagues send wishes

The announcement drew an immediate wave of congratulatory messages from across the Hindi film industry. Kriti Sanon wrote, "Congratulations you guys!!! Dua has a baby sister!!! Such a blessing!" Anil Kapoor kept it to three words — "Girls are the best" — while Sonam Kapoor called it "what a dream" and Neil Nitin Mukesh wrote, "God bless the baby and the family." Neha Dhupia and Sonu Sood were among the others who extended their wishes.

"Congratulations you guys!!! Dua has a baby sister!!! Such a blessing!"

— Kriti Sanon, actor

A decade-long partnership, on and off screen

The announcement marks another chapter in one of Hindi cinema's most-watched partnerships. Deepika and Ranveer first worked together on Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela (2013), and their romance reportedly developed during that shoot. After several years of dating, they married on November 14 and 15, 2018, in an intimate destination wedding at Villa del Balbianello on Lake Como, Italy, with ceremonies observing both Konkani and Sindhi traditions.

Motherhood has reshaped Deepika's public persona in ways she has discussed openly. In an October 2025 interview with CNBC-TV18, she said becoming a parent pushed her beyond her comfort zone and made her more social, through interactions with other parents and her daughter's playschool. She has also been a vocal advocate of women's safety and has spoken critically about punishing film shoot schedules — positions that have kept her in the news well beyond her screen roles.

What's next: two packed slates

The second child arrives amid demanding professional schedules for both actors. Deepika is set to appear in Siddharth Anand's King alongside Shah Rukh Khan, and is also part of Atlee's upcoming sci-fi action film Raaka, headlined by Allu Arjun. Ranveer is filming Pralay, described as a post-apocalyptic action survival thriller directed by Jai Mehta and co-starring Kalyani Priyadarshan — and he is coming off a commercial high, with the two Dhurandhar films earning more than 3,000 crore from theatres worldwide, according to Cinema Express.

For the Indian diaspora, which counts the couple among its most closely followed cultural figures, the announcement is the kind of shared family milestone that travels instantly across WhatsApp groups and community feeds. Like the stars themselves, many diaspora parents are navigating careers and young families at once — and few couples illustrate that balancing act on as public a stage.
